description: Automatic score recording for authenticated players and global leaderboard with all-time and daily views

userStories.title: Create leaderboard.js and score recording logic
userStories.description: As an authenticated player, I want my score recorded automatically when the game ends so that I can compete on the leaderboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Create leaderboard.js file, loaded in index.html after auth.js and before game.js
Export a recordScore(score, wave) async function that inserts into the scores table using supabaseClient with player_id from currentUser.id
Call recordScore() from gameOver() in game.js when currentUser is not null
If the insert fails, log the error to console but don't block the game over screen
Store a pendingScore variable ({ score, wave }) when currentUser is null on game over, for later save after sign-in
Clicking Play Again clears pendingScore
Verify a score row appears in Supabase scores table after an authenticated game over
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Save pending score after guest signs in
userStories.description: As a guest who just played, I want my score saved if I sign in from the game over screen so that my game wasn't wasted.
acceptanceCriteria: After successful login or registration in auth.js (handleLogin and handleRegister), check if pendingScore exists
If pendingScore exists, call recordScore(pendingScore.score, pendingScore.wave) then clear pendingScore
The score is saved with the newly authenticated user's ID
If the guest clicks Play Again instead of signing in, pendingScore is cleared and no score is saved
Verify in browser: play as guest, game over, sign in, check scores table has the entry
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Guest prompt on game over screen
userStories.description: As a guest, I want to see a message encouraging me to sign in to save my score, but I can skip it.
acceptanceCriteria: When game over fires and currentUser is null, show text on the game over screen: 'Sign in to save your score to the leaderboard'
The existing Sign In button from previous work is visible below this message
The Play Again button is always visible regardless of auth state
When currentUser is not null, the prompt message is hidden
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Leaderboard fetch and render function
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a reusable function to fetch and render leaderboard data so both the start screen and game over screen can use it.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a fetchLeaderboard(period) async function in leaderboard.js that queries the top 10 scores from the scores table joined with profiles for username
period parameter accepts 'alltime' (default) or 'daily'
For 'daily', filter scores where played_at >= start of today in UTC
Returns an array of { rank, username, score, played_at } objects sorted by score descending
Create a renderLeaderboard(containerEl, scores, currentUserId) function that renders a table/list into the given container element
Each row shows: rank number, username, score, date (formatted short like 'May 14')
If scores array is empty, render 'No scores recorded yet'
Verify fetchLeaderboard returns data by logging to console after inserting a test score

userStories.title: Leaderboard overlay on start screen
userStories.description: As a user, I want to open a leaderboard from the start screen so that I can see top scores before playing.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Leaderboard' button is visible on the start screen alongside Start Game and auth buttons
Clicking it hides the main start screen content and shows a leaderboard view (same pattern as auth forms)
The leaderboard view contains a title 'Leaderboard', the rendered leaderboard table, and a 'Back' link
The leaderboard fetches and displays top 10 all-time scores on open
A 'Back' link returns to the main start screen
Styling matches existing dark background, sans-serif font, clean modern look
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Leaderboard on game over screen
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see the leaderboard on the game over screen so that I can immediately see how I rank.
acceptanceCriteria: The game over screen includes a leaderboard container below the Play Again button and auth buttons
When the game over screen appears, fetchLeaderboard('alltime') is called and the result is rendered into the container
The leaderboard shows top 10 scores with rank, username, score, and date
If there are no scores, shows 'No scores recorded yet'
The leaderboard is compact and doesn't overflow the game over overlay — use max-height with scroll if needed
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: All-time and daily toggle
userStories.description: As a user, I want to switch between all-time and daily leaderboard views so that I can see who is performing best today.
acceptanceCriteria: A toggle with two buttons/tabs ('All Time' and 'Today') is visible above the leaderboard on both start screen and game over screen
'All Time' is selected by default with a visually active state (e.g., underline or background highlight)
Clicking 'Today' re-fetches with fetchLeaderboard('daily') and re-renders the leaderboard
Clicking 'All Time' re-fetches with fetchLeaderboard('alltime') and re-renders
Both views rank scores highest to lowest
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Highlight current player and show rank outside top 10
userStories.description: As an authenticated player, I want my best score highlighted and my rank shown even if I'm not in the top 10.
acceptanceCriteria: If the current player has a score in the top 10, their row has a distinct visual highlight (e.g., subtle blue background or left border using #4a9eff)
If the current player is NOT in the top 10 but has scores, fetch their best score and rank separately
Player rank = count of distinct higher scores + 1
Display an additional row at the bottom of the leaderboard, separated by a '...' divider row, showing the player's rank, username, score, and date
If the player has no scores, no extra row is shown
Works on both start screen and game over leaderboard views, respecting the current alltime/daily toggle
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
